children: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – NOVEMBER 13th, 2026 –– TheNewswire - HYPER BIT TECHNOLOGIES LTD.

(the “Company”, “Hyper Bit”, or “HYPE”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Yoshito Okubo as Chief Executive Officer as well as the addition of Mr. Cole Drezdoff to the board of directors effective immediately. These strategic changes and addition to the Hyper Bit board add significant depth and experience within the digital assets and artificial intelligence “AI” sectors.

"We are pleased to welcome Mr. Drezdoff to Hyper Bit’s Board as we advance existing crypto mining operations and evaluate new opportunities across digital assets and AI infrastructure,” said Yoshito Okubo, CEO and a director of Hyper Bit. “Mr. Drezdoff brings a commercially focused perspective and experience in business development, digital marketing and stakeholder communications. His skills will strengthen our team as we refine our strategy, build relationships and communicate our progress to shareholders.”

Mr. Drezdoff is a commercially focused marketing and business development professional with experience in digital asset strategies, technology and AI market research, investor engagement and client growth initiatives. He developed an early interest in emerging blockchain technologies and digital assets, becoming involved in the cryptocurrency space in 2016. A graduate of Toronto Metropolitan University's Ted Rogers School of Management with a Bachelor of Commerce in Marketing Management, he has supported companies in strengthening brand visibility, improving stakeholder communications and driving business development. His experience spans digital marketing, social media, lead generation, operations, client engagement and financial communications, giving him a practical, entrepreneurial approach to helping businesses execute growth strategies and expand commercial opportunities.

Hyper Bit Technologies Ltd. is a forward-thinking, diversified technology company specializing in the acquisition, development, and strategic deployment of crypto mining operations and blockchain-based innovations. As global interest in digital assets accelerates—driven by the rise of blockchain, decentralized finance (DeFi), and increasing institutional and retail adoption—Hyper Bit is committed to unlocking value across the crypto ecosystem while delivering growth for our stakeholders. Hyper Bit Technologies Ltd. is a member of the Blockchain Association of Canada and the American Blockchain & Cryptocurrency Association.

Stay informed on our latest developments by subscribing to Company updates at Hyperbit.ca and follow us across our social media channels: X.com, TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. Hyper Bit Technologies Ltd. is publicly listed in Canada
